title: MiFID Compliance Officer
description:
About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.
Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.
Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

About Bybit

Bybit is a leading global cryptocurrency exchange, founded in 2018 by Ben Zhou. Headquartered in Dubai, Bybit has rapidly grown to serve over 80 million users worldwide, making it the world's second-largest crypto exchange by trading volume.
Our mission is to empower individuals and institutions to realize the full potential of crypto and Web3 technologies. Bybit offers a comprehensive suite of trading options, including spot and derivatives trading, as well as innovative products like the Bybit Card and the Bybit Wallet. We are committed to providing a secure, transparent, and user-friendly platform, underpinned by industry-leading security measures and 24/7 customer support.
In 2025, Bybit established its European headquarters in Vienna, Austria, reinforcing its commitment to the European market and regulatory compliance. As first international exchange, we managed to secure the MiCAR license in Austria in May 2025 and have started operations under the fully regulated EU website bybit.eu in July 2025. This strategic move positions Bybit at the heart of Europe, enabling closer collaboration with regulatory bodies and providing enhanced services to its European user base.
This is just the beginning of our journey to become a fully integrated financial platform, offering a diverse multitude of services across the EEA.

About the role and the job scope

Based in our Vienna, Austria headquarters, the MiFID Compliance Officer is a critical regulatory role within our expanding European operations. You will act as the primary legal and compliance expert for investment services, ensuring our platform adheres strictly to European and Austrian capital markets regulations.
Your efforts will directly shape and safeguard our regulatory framework as we expand our service offerings across the EEA. You will be responsible for translating complex regulatory requirements into actionable internal policies, advising leadership, and maintaining the highest standards of market integrity.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Establish, manage, and continuously improve a robust compliance framework in accordance with MiFID II and the Austrian Securities Supervision Act 2018 (WAG 2018).
  • Draft, implement, and maintain internal policies, procedures, and controls relevant to the Compliance area.
  • Act as the subject matter expert on investment services and activities under MiFID II / WAG 2018, providing regulatory guidance to internal teams.
  • Prepare and deliver clear, actionable reports on compliance topics to senior management and the Board.
  • Oversee and advise on complaints handling processes, ensuring alignment with relevant regulatory requirements and internal standards.
  • Monitor regulatory developments in European capital markets and proactively adapt internal frameworks to ensure ongoing compliance.

Why to Join

At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment. Our benefits include:
  • Modern Workspace: Work in Austria's tallest office building, offering state-of-the-art facilities and panoramic views of Vienna.
  • Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
  • Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.
  • Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.

What to bring

  1. Legal Background: University degree in Law and qualification as a legal professional.
  2. Industry Experience: at least 5 years of experience in a compliance department at an investment firm, in the capital markets division of a bank, a reputable law firm or regulator.
  3. Policy Expertise: Profound experience in the preparation and implementation of policies and procedures relevant to the Compliance area.
  4. Regulatory Knowledge: Deep understanding of investment services and activities under MiFID II / WAG 2018 and the broader regulatory framework.
  5. Framework Management: Ideally, a proven track record of having successfully established or managed a compliance framework under MiFID II / WAG 2018.
  6. Leadership Communication: Experienced in senior management reporting and presenting complex compliance topics clearly to executive stakeholders.
  7. Process Oversight: At least a basic knowledge of complaints handling processes and their associated regulatory requirements.
  8. Languages: Excellent communication skills with fluency in both German and English required.
Join us and be part of shaping the future of finance and technology.

Why Join Us
At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment.
Our benefits include:
- Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
- Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
- Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.
- Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.
- Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.
